# Splits around the dot, but keep it. The time is right-truncated.
    dot_pos = value.rfind('.')
    if dot_pos > 0:
        value = value[:dot_pos] + '.' + value[dot_pos + 1:dot_pos + 7]

    # Remove timezone designator (Z, +hh:mm, -hh:mm, +hhmm, -hhmm, +hh, -hh)
    # strptime does not handle these suffixes.
    if value.endswith('Z'):
        value = value[:-1]
    else:
        # Look for + or - timezone offset after the time portion
        # (avoid matching the date separators)
        tz_pos = max(value.rfind('+'), value.rfind('-'))
        if tz_pos > 10:  # after 'YYYY-MM-DDT'
            value = value[:tz_pos]

    return dt.datetime.strptime(value, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f')
